titleInfo.title: What the CEO wants you to know
titleInfo.subTitle: how your company really works

titleInfo.title: Using business acumen to understand how your company really works

abstract.#text: A powerful lesson in what is really important in business, this remarkable book by an ultimate insider takes the lessons of the peddler and reveals how they can be used by the rest of us. Reminiscent of bestsellers such as "Who Moved My Cheese?" and" The One-Minute Manager, What the CEO Wants You to Know" is simple, direct, and of immense use to everyone in business.

tableOfContents.#text: What Jack Welch and street vendors share : the essence of business thinking -- Every business is the same inside : cutting through to cash, margin, velocity, growth and customers -- Understanding your company's total business : how the pieces come together -- The world has complexity, leaders provide clarity : figuring out business priorities -- Wealth is more than making money : seeing the business like an investor -- Growing people takes courage : making matches, fixing mismatches -- Making groups decisive : designing social operating mechanisms -- What to do and how to do it : a CEO with an edge in execution -- Your part in the big picture : rekindling the spirit of the lemonade stand.

physicalLocation.#text: Baker Library, Harvard Business School, Harvard University
